Definition: a pile (of stones), i.e. (figuratively) a throng
BiblicalUsage: Read rigmâh as a pile (of stones), that is (figuratively) a throng. It stands in Psalms 68:27: "There little Benjamin their ruler, the princes of…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that rigmâh counts, because God put it in his book.
